effects.name: rebind-generation-continuity
effects.system: the project's Vouch store (its event log and state.json)
effects.detail: rebind-pack after a respecify and re-freeze commits its record and keeps every earlier rebind row; a commit, an event-log replay or a merge source chain holding an AcceptancePackRebound whose old inventory or old test set is not the unit's current value immediately before it is refused with rebind.history-disconnected and writes nothing; event, log and snapshot formats are unchanged
